9 MR. WELLS: Mr. Chief Justice, and may it
please the Court:

19 were intended to be and are different than and in
addition to the Federal rules regarding the handling of
21 nonambulatory animals.
22 Where Federal law sets requirements for
23 receipt and allows for receipt if the -- if those rules

altogether.
